decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That details for the reduction in height of the proposed garage from 5.8m to 5.5m to match the height of the adjoining property, number 6 Upper Butts, which would involve  reducing the existing rear brick wall by no more than 7 courses of bricks  leaving at least one course of bricks above the buttress on the northwest corner,  pursuant to Condition 3 of approval ref. 01025/19/P1 for the  demolition of the  existing rear extension and erection of single storey rear extension and garage to existing dwellinghouse  dated 23/12/2003, received 22/11/2004,  be approved
description: Following approval for the demolition of existing rear extension and erection of a single storey rear extension, and  garage to existing dwellinghouse- details submitted pursuant to condition 3 (in accordance with plans to allow for the reduction in height of the garage) of planning permission reference 01025/19/P1 dated 23/12/03
